methodologies.title: AI fundamentals
methodologies.summary: Learn the distinction between AI, machine learning and deep learning.
details: Implementation
Choose a measurable prediction task; split data into training, validation and test sets.
Validation and safety
Compare a simple baseline against a learned model; check errors and distribution shift.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Large language models
methodologies.summary: Understand tokens, embeddings, transformers and inference.
details: Implementation
Tokenize input, apply transformer layers and sample output tokens autoregressively.
Validation and safety
Evaluate on held-out tasks; account for context limits and hallucinations.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Prompt engineering
methodologies.summary: Design instructions, examples and output contracts.
details: Implementation
Specify task, context, constraints, examples and output format.
Validation and safety
Test against difficult examples and compare outputs using a rubric.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Retrieval augmented generation
methodologies.summary: Ground answers in retrieved source material.
details: Implementation
Ingest approved documents, chunk and embed them; retrieve relevant passages and provide them to the model with citations.
Validation and safety
Measure retrieval recall and answer faithfulness; handle missing evidence explicitly.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Agentic AI
methodologies.summary: Build systems that plan and invoke tools.
details: Implementation
Define a bounded goal, permitted tools, state and stop conditions; require approval for consequential actions.
Validation and safety
Test tool failures, prompt injection and runaway loops; enforce budgets.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Model Context Protocol
methodologies.summary: Connect models to tools and resources using a standard interface.
details: Implementation
Configure a client and authorized servers; discover tools and validate arguments before execution.
Validation and safety
Apply least privilege, validate untrusted results and audit sensitive operations.

Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Fine tuning and LoRA
methodologies.summary: Adapt a model to a task with training examples.
details: Implementation
Prepare representative input/output examples; train parameter-efficient adapters and keep a held-out test set.
Validation and safety
Compare against prompting and RAG; check regressions and memorization.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Multimodal AI
methodologies.summary: Work with text, images, audio and video.
details: Implementation
Choose models supporting required modalities and preprocess inputs according to their specifications.
Validation and safety
Evaluate each modality and cross-modal tasks; avoid exposing private media.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: LLMOps and evaluation
methodologies.summary: Operate AI applications reliably in production.
details: Implementation
Version prompts, models and data; capture latency, cost and quality metrics.
Validation and safety
Use regression evaluations, redacted traces, rollback and monitoring.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: AI security
methodologies.summary: Defend AI systems against misuse and unsafe data access.
details: Implementation
Treat external content as untrusted; isolate credentials and restrict tool permissions.
Validation and safety
Red-team prompt injection, data leakage and unsafe tool execution.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

methodologies.title: Vector search
details: Implementation
Embed documents and queries; combine nearest-neighbor search with metadata filters and lexical search.
Validation and safety
Measure retrieval recall and precision on representative queries.
Hands-on exercise
Build a small prototype using public or synthetic data. Record the baseline, test cases, failures and improvements before scaling.

details: Implementation
Define triggers, schemas, routing, retries and human review points.
Validation and safety
Use idempotency keys and test failures before enabling schedules.

prompts.title: Technical RCA
details: Copy this template
Analyze [redacted logs]. Create a timeline with timestamps and source lines. Separate facts, hypotheses and missing evidence. Propose safe verification steps before remediation.
Usage
Replace bracketed placeholders with approved data. Verify the answer and never include credentials or confidential data in unapproved systems.

details: Copy this template

Usage
